newsitem.title: THAILAND: Shinawatra Satel delays satellite launch.
newsitem.headline: Shinawatra Satel delays satellite launch.

text.p: Thailand's satellite operator, Shinawatra Satellite Plc, said on Monday it had postponed the launch of its Thaicom 3 satellite to early next year.
The postponement of the launch, originally scheduled for late this year, was in order to improve Thaicom 3's transmission capability and effectiveness, the group said in a statement.
Thaicom 3 is expected to be completely built and ready for launch into orbit next February, the statement said.
